decision: Use the native runner image record as the fixed authority on both comparison conditions, regardless of its value; keep environment values and conflicts as diagnostics.
reason: The introduced v1 equality gate stopped actual work because a separately populated environment version disagreed with the native image file. The native file agrees with GitHub's Set up job header, which GitHub documents as the exact runner inventory reference. Re-running until redundant sources happen to agree is not a valid recovery.
retained_controls: Exactly one valid supported native image record
Unchanged raw native-image and OS bytes between early capture and publication
Exact canonical image version and raw file hashes compared per owner
All required jobs and 108 browser cases must actually execute
Old v1 failures remain failed; no retroactive acceptance
Original measurement thresholds and all-warm controls remain unchanged
cause_of_environment_disagreement: Not established; no claim that either provider script is conclusively stale.
authorization: Current user's explicit recovery request delegated approach choice and scoped fixes. This is an ordinary correction to the newly added gate in the same Plan254-08, not a new numbered repair plan.
